description: How much paint, how many drywall sheets or how many boxes of flooring a rectangular room needs, with an adjustable waste allowance. Quantities only. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/renovation-materials-calculator?material=paint&units=ft&length=12&width=10&height=8&openings=40&coats=2&coverage=350

box_coverage.description: Coverage printed on one box of flooring (floor) (sq ft or m2)

coverage.description: Coverage printed on the paint can (paint) (sq ft per gallon or m2 per litre)

openings.description: Doors and windows to subtract (paint and drywall) (area in sq ft or m2)

sheet.description: Drywall sheet length in feet, 4 ft wide (drywall)

units.description: ft = feet, sq ft and gallons; m = metres, m2 and litres

waste.description: Waste allowance in percent (drywall and floor) (%)
